knowledge.claim: content retrieved from the web can act as instructions to an LLM agent (indirect prompt injection) and must be treated as untrusted data
knowledge.note: corroborated by ≥2 INDEPENDENT accessible sources (secondary sources — official primary not confirmed); still a MODEL conclusion, not an absolute fact
knowledge.grounds: stampFinding/sanitizeExternal: retrieved content = untrusted data; never instructions

knowledge.claim: system-level designs that prevent untrusted data from changing an agent's control flow give stronger prompt-injection resistance than model-level filtering
knowledge.note: single accessible source — NOT verified knowledge; needs independent corroboration
knowledge.grounds: the GRANT (exact hosts + prefixes), not retrieved content, fixes what is fetched

knowledge.claim: a robots.txt 4xx response allows access while an unreachable or 5xx robots.txt must be treated as complete disallow
knowledge.note: single accessible source — NOT verified knowledge; needs independent corroboration

knowledge.claim: robots.txt is not a form of access authorization
knowledge.note: single accessible source — NOT verified knowledge; needs independent corroboration
knowledge.grounds: robots ALLOW is necessary, never sufficient: terms + access type + flags still required

knowledge.claim: egress for automated clients should be allowlist-first with internal and private addresses blocked
knowledge.note: corroborated by ≥2 INDEPENDENT accessible sources (secondary sources — official primary not confirmed); still a MODEL conclusion, not an absolute fact
knowledge.grounds: validHost refuses IP literals, localhost/.local/.internal; hostMatch EXACT

knowledge.claim: redirect following should be disabled for allowlisted outbound requests to prevent server-side request forgery
knowledge.note: recorded as RECOMMENDATION — never promoted to fact
knowledge.grounds: OFF_HOST redirect on a prefix ⇒ REFUSE; same-host redirect ⇒ non-canonical prefix ⇒ DEFER (transport blocks redirects)

knowledge.claim: current prompt-injection defenses do not eliminate the risk for agents that process untrusted content
knowledge.note: corroborated by ≥2 INDEPENDENT accessible sources (secondary sources — official primary not confirmed); still a MODEL conclusion, not an absolute fact
knowledge.grounds: defense in depth: the admission/grant bounds exposure even if content filtering fails

knowledge.claim: the unauthenticated GitHub REST API primary rate limit is 60 requests per hour
knowledge.note: single accessible source — NOT verified knowledge; needs independent corroboration
knowledge.grounds: api.github.com DEFERRED: 60/h < 4 × per-run budget and no per-host cumulative cap

knowledge.claim: the arXiv API terms ask for no more than one request every three seconds on a single connection
knowledge.note: single accessible source — NOT verified knowledge; needs independent corroboration
knowledge.grounds: export.arxiv.org: terms vs robots Disallow contradiction ⇒ REFUSE/owner decision; per-host pacing absent

knowledge.claim: the Crossref public pool limits queries to one request per second with concurrency one
knowledge.note: single accessible source — NOT verified knowledge; needs independent corroboration
knowledge.grounds: api.crossref.org DEFERRED: per-second/concurrency limits not enforceable without per-host pacing

honesty: claim→reference attribution is the coordinating session's judgement from each reference's recorded contribution (provider work, auditable here)
independence is by HOST: several arXiv papers are one host and do not corroborate each other
FACT_CORROBORATED is still a model conclusion over fetched pages, not an absolute fact; single-source claims are NOT verified knowledge
